title: Can an Interactive Dashboard Teach Polling Literacy? Evidence from a Large-Scale Experiment
authors: Simon Munzert, Linus Hagemann, Elias Koch, Hannah Rajski, Thomas Gschwend, Cornelius Erfort, and Lukas F. Stoetzer.
abstract: Pre-registered experiment (N = 52,765, 2025 German election): an interactive dashboard simulating sample design, recruitment, and weighting. None of three pre-registered outcomes improve as intended—knowledge, attitudes, and appreciation of weighting are null or move the wrong way—suggesting interactive tools need stronger pedagogy.
